'''Dnag Fl'od''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During the [[third Galactic War]] he was stationed at the [[Joint Operations Base]] of the [[Invasion Zone]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], where he provided teaching to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="Legacy" />
